## Acceptance criteria

All three requirements are met. The deterministic renderer covers all built-ins and gate/checker fields in [reference.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/gate_presets/reference.rs:37), [reference.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/gate_presets/reference.rs:49), and the committed reference. It explicitly separates shipped presets from project-local configuration in [gate-presets.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/gate-presets.md:16). The byte-for-byte freshness test is in [reference.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/gate_presets/reference.rs:245).

## Architecture and functional style

Pass. Projection logic is isolated in `gate_presets`, does not add I/O to domain code, and uses deterministic sorting plus iterator pipelines.

## Correctness, safety, and error handling

Pass. Checker metadata is fully rendered, including environment values in sorted order. The regeneration helper uses temp-file then rename. No unsafe code, PID handling, lifecycle, or storage-boundary regression is introduced.

## Testing

Pass. Recorded `cargo-ci` succeeded: fmt and clippy passed; 3,668 tests passed with zero failures. Per instruction, I did not rerun tests. The new unit coverage checks freshness, completeness, exact built-in membership, determinism, checker fields, and markdown escaping.

## CLI contract and documentation

Pass. No CLI surface changed. The new public exports have descriptions and examples. The generated reference is discoverable from [docs/index.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/index.md:60) and cited from relevant preset documentation.

## JIT issue management and prior feedback

Pass. The sole dependency is done. `./scripts/jit-validate.sh` passed. `run_history` is empty, so there is no prior review feedback to reconcile.
